preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 10^5.
The number of ants is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= u_i, v_i <= n for all edges
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the range of the tree's vertices.

preconditions.expression: a_i != b_i and c_i != d_i for all ants
preconditions.description: Each ant's favorite pairs consist of distinct vertices.

postconditions.description: The output indicates whether it is possible to paint the tree edges to satisfy all ants.

postconditions.expression: if 'YES', then output m lines with 1 or 2 for each ant
postconditions.description: Each line indicates which of the ant's favorite pairs should be used for painting the edges.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i <= n) for all ants
invariants.description: All vertices in the favorite pairs are within the range of the tree's vertices.

invariants.expression: all(a_i != b_i and c_i != d_i) for all ants
invariants.description: No ant's favorite pairs contain the same vertex.
